Token._comment_IssuerSigningKey: DEV-ONLY DUMMY KEY, COMMITTED ON PURPOSE. It exists so that a clone of this repository starts and issues test tokens with one command. It is not a secret, it is not rotated, and anyone reading this file can mint a token the sample host will accept. Never reuse this value, and never ship a symmetric signing key in configuration for a real SCIM endpoint - use a real OAuth authority instead. This file is layered over appsettings.json only when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development. The value was lengthened from 24 to 32 characters during the net48/net10 port: IdentityModel 8.x enforces HS256's 256-bit minimum key size, which the previous 192-bit value fails outright. Keep it at 32 characters or longer.
